info.title: HamzaTex API
info.description: Textile ERP — staff mobile + admin backend. All endpoints require a JWT Bearer token except Auth.

get.summary: Health check — returns 200 OK when the API is running.
API info — returns links to docs and health endpoints.
Downloads the OpenAPI JSON spec file. Use this in Orval: set target to the URL of this endpoint.

post.summary: Register a new user account. Creates a Staff user and sends a 6-digit email verification OTP.
Login with username and password. Returns a JWT access token and a refresh token.
Logout. If a refresh token is provided, revokes that token only. Otherwise revokes all tokens for the current user.
Exchange a valid refresh token for a new JWT access token and rotated refresh token.
Change the current user's password. Requires the existing password for verification.

get.summary: Confirm a user's email address using the token sent in the confirmation email. Returns an HTML page.

post.summary: Resend the email confirmation link to the given email address.
Verify the 6-digit email verification code sent during signup. Marks email as confirmed on success.
Resend the signup email verification OTP. Enforces a 30-second cooldown between requests.
Send a 6-digit OTP to the given email address. Enforces a 30-second resend cooldown.
Verify the 6-digit OTP. Returns a short-lived reset token on success.
Reset the user's password using the reset token obtained from OTP verification.
Enable biometric authentication for the current user. Returns a long-lived biometric token.
Login using a biometric token. Validates the token and returns fresh access + refresh tokens.

delete.summary: Disable biometric authentication for the current user. Revokes all biometric tokens.

get.summary: Get paginated clients. Staff see their own; Admin sees all clients across all users.

post.summary: Create a new client (customer or supplier) for the authenticated user.

get.summary: Get all clients (unpaginated). Admin sees all; non-admins see only their own. Prefer the paginated `GET /Filtered` for list UIs; this powers exports and pickers.
Get a single client by ID.

delete.summary: Delete a client by ID. Admin only.

get.summary: Download a client list as a PDF report. Admin sees all clients; non-admins see only their own.
Download a single client's full dossier as a branded PDF — profile, orders, purchases, payments, recent transactions, and current balance. Reuses the report aggregate so figures match the screen.

post.summary: Create a new client type.

get.summary: Get all client types.
Get a single client type by ID.

put.summary: Update a client type by ID.

delete.summary: Delete a client type by ID.

get.summary: Download all client types as a PDF report.
Role-scoped dashboard summary: financials, operations, alerts, recent orders.
Last N months of aggregated financials for charts. Query param: ?months=6 (1-12).

post.summary:
Validate a push notification payload against FCM using dry_run mode.
No message is delivered to any device. Returns the FCM message ID and the full data payload that would be sent.
Supported types: order_created, order_delivered, order_cancelled, purchase_delivered,
payment_received, payment_paid, payment_reversed, invoice_issued, invoice_overdue,
low_stock, expense_approved, sync_complete, sync_partial, sync_failed.
Register or refresh an FCM device token for push notifications.

delete.summary: Unregister a specific FCM device token (e.g. on logout from this device).
Unregister all FCM device tokens for the authenticated user (e.g. on logout-all).

post.summary: Create an expense and atomically post a Debit transaction to the ledger.

get.summary: Get all expenses paginated. Staff see only their own; Admin sees all.
Get an expense by ID.

put.summary: Update amount, mode, date, and notes. TransCategoryId cannot be changed — delete and re-create to reclassify.

delete.summary: Hard delete an expense and its linked Transaction. Admin only.

get.summary: Filter expenses by type, mode, and date range. Admin sees all matches; non-admins see only their own.
Export expenses as PDF. Admin sees all; non-admins see only their own. Optionally filter by type, mode, and date range.
Download a single expense as a branded PDF receipt — type, amount, and details.

post.summary: Create a new expense type.

get.summary: Get all expense types.
Get an expense type by ID.

delete.summary: Delete an expense type. Fails if the type is seeded (ID 1 or 2) or has existing expenses.

get.summary: Download all expense types as a PDF report.

post.summary: Create a standalone invoice.

get.summary: Get all invoices paginated. Admin only.
Get a single invoice with lines and linked transactions.

put.summary: Update invoice status, dueDate, notes, totalAmount, and/or lines.

delete.summary: Delete a Draft invoice created within the last year. Admin only.

get.summary: Get all invoices for a client with aggregate stats.
Filter invoices by statusId, clientId, dateFrom, dateTo.
Export all invoices as a branded PDF with stat cards.
Export a single invoice as a formal branded PDF.
Export all invoices for a client as a PDF with aggregate stat cards.
Export filtered invoices as a PDF.
Returns all lookup tables in a single response. Cache this on the frontend at app startup.

Get a single lookup table by type name.
Accepts camelCase (orderStatuses) or kebab-case (order-statuses).
Returns 400 with a list of valid type names if the type is unknown.
Get all notifications for the current user. Pass unreadOnly=true and/or limit to filter.
Get the count of unread notifications for the current user.

patch.summary: Mark a single notification as read.
Mark all notifications as read for the current user.

post.summary: Create a new order with lines. Client must be a Customer (ClientTypeId=1).

get.summary: Get all orders, paginated. Staff see only their own; Admin sees all.
Get a single order by ID with lines.

put.summary: Update an order header. Handles status transitions: Delivered triggers stock+ledger, Cancelled reverses them.

delete.summary: Delete an order and its lines. Admin only. Not allowed if order has been Delivered.

get.summary: Filter orders by clientId, statusId, and/or date range.

put.summary: Replace all lines on a Pending or InProgress order. Syncs the linked Draft invoice. Blocked for Delivered/Cancelled orders.

get.summary: Download an orders PDF report. Admin sees all orders; non-admins see only their own.
Download a single order as a branded PDF dossier — header, line items, totals, and payment status.

post.summary: Create a payment. Allocates to orders/purchases (manual or auto-FIFO) and posts to the ledger.

get.summary: Get all payments paginated. Staff see only their own; Admin sees all.
Get a payment by ID with its allocations.

put.summary: Update payment notes, date, and transaction mode. Amount and client cannot be changed.

delete.summary: Hard delete a payment, its allocations, and linked Transaction. Admin only.

get.summary: Get all payments for a specific client.
Filter payments by clientId, directionId, modeId, date range, and reversed flag.
Get unallocated credit balance for a client.

post.summary: Reverse a payment (e.g. wrong amount). Creates a reversing Transaction and marks original as reversed.
Reverse a payment and re-create it for the correct client. Atomic operation for wrong-client corrections.

get.summary: Export payments as PDF. Admin sees all; non-admins see only their own.
Download a single payment as a branded PDF receipt — party, direction/mode, amount, and allocations.

post.summary: Create a new product and link it to the authenticated user. Records an initial stock movement for the opening quantity.

get.summary: Get all products for the authenticated user.
Get a single product by ID scoped to the authenticated user.

put.summary: Update product details. Do not use this to adjust stock — create a Manual StockMovement instead.

get.summary: Get paginated products for the authenticated user.
Download the authenticated user's product list as a PDF report. Summary shows total inventory value (Qty × Price).
Download a single product's full dossier as a branded PDF — profile, valuation, and complete stock-movement history. Scoped to the authenticated user's products.

post.summary: Create a new purchase with lines. Supplier must be a Client with ClientTypeId=2.

get.summary: Get all purchases, paginated. Staff see only their own; Admin sees all.
Get a single purchase by ID with lines.

put.summary: Update a purchase header. Handles status transitions: Delivered triggers stock In + ledger, Cancelled reverses them.

delete.summary: Delete a purchase and its lines. Admin only. Not allowed if purchase has been Delivered.

get.summary: Filter purchases by supplierId, statusId, and/or date range.

put.summary: Replace all lines on a Pending or InProgress purchase. Syncs the linked Draft invoice. Blocked for Delivered/Cancelled purchases.

get.summary: Download a purchases PDF report. Admin sees all purchases; non-admins see only their own.
Download a single purchase as a branded PDF dossier — supplier, line items, totals, and payment status.
Monthly profit and loss report. Optionally filter by year and/or month.
Export profit and loss report as PDF. Accepts same year/month filters.
All client balances.
Single client balance by ID. Staff can access their own clients.
Export all client balances as PDF.
Monthly credit/debit report. Optionally filter by year and/or month.
Export credit/debit report as PDF. Accepts same year/month filters.
Aggregate totals: sales, purchases, expenses amounts and order/purchase/client counts.
Export summary totals as PDF.
Per-client breakdown with order/purchase totals, payments, recent transactions, and balance.
Full detail for a single client — orders, purchases, payments, recent transactions, and balance.
Export full single client detail as PDF with orders, purchases, payments, and transactions.
Export per-client overview — all clients with order, purchase, and balance totals.

post.summary: Record a new stock movement. MovementType is auto-derived for Purchase (In) and Sale (Out); required only for Manual source.

get.summary: Get all stock movements, paginated. Non-admins see only movements for their own products; Admin sees all.
Get a single stock movement by ID.

put.summary: Update a stock movement record. Does not recalculate product averages — use a new Manual movement for stock corrections.

delete.summary: Delete a stock movement record. Admin only.

get.summary: Filter stock movements by product, type, source, and/or date range.
Get all stock movements for a specific product ordered chronologically. Admin sees all; Staff scoped to their own products.
Download all stock movements as a PDF report.
Download a single stock movement as a branded PDF receipt — product, type/source, quantities, and value snapshots.

post.summary: Create a manual ledger entry. Defaults TransTypeId=1 (Debit) and TransModeId=1 (Cash) if omitted.

get.summary: Get all transactions paginated. Staff see only their own; Admin sees all.

put.summary: Update a manually-created transaction. Returns an error if the transaction was auto-posted by an Order, Purchase, Expense, or Payment.

delete.summary: Delete a manually-created transaction. Returns an error if the transaction was auto-posted.

get.summary: Get a transaction by ID. Staff can only access their own records.
Get all transactions for a specific client. Staff: only if they own the client.
Filter transactions by typeId, categoryId, modeId, clientId, dateFrom, dateTo. Admin sees all matches; non-admins see only their own.
Export transactions as PDF. Admin sees all; non-admins see only their own.
Download a single transaction as a branded PDF ledger slip — category/type/mode, amount, and linked party.

post.summary: Create a new user role.

get.summary: Get all user roles.
Get a single user role by ID.

put.summary: Update a user role by ID.

delete.summary: Delete a user role by ID.

get.summary: Download all user roles as a PDF report.

post.summary: Admin creates a new pre-confirmed user account. No email confirmation required.

get.summary: Get all users.
Get a user by ID.

delete.summary: Delete a user by ID. Admin only.

put.summary: Update the authenticated user's own profile (name, email, username, phone).

get.summary: Download all users as a PDF report.

clientTypeName.description: Resolved name of the ClientType lookup (e.g. "Customer", "Supplier"). Populated on read.

transCategoryId.description: Optional. Auto-derived from ExpenseTypeId for seeded types (Office→3, Home→4). Required for custom expense types with no built-in mapping.

expenseDate.description: Omit or set null to use today's UTC date.
Omit or set null to leave the existing date unchanged.

InvoiceByClientDto.description: Client invoice summary: aggregate stats + per-invoice list.

InvoiceDetailDto.description: Full invoice detail including lines and linked transactions.

InvoiceDto.description: Flat invoice row used in paginated list, filtered, and by-client responses.

LookupDto.description: Generic shape for all seeded lookup / enum-style tables.

LookupsAllDto.description:
Combined payload returned by GET /api/Lookups/all.
Frontend fetches this once at startup and caches locally.

orderDate.description: Omit or null to use the current UTC date.

paymentTypeId.description: Omit or null to leave the existing payment type unchanged.

orderDate.description: Omit or null to leave the existing order date unchanged.

paymentDate.description: Omit or set null to use the current UTC date.
Omit or set null to leave the existing payment date unchanged.

availableQuantity.description: On-hand Quantity minus qty already committed to other non-Delivered, non-Cancelled orders for this product. Use this for stock checks instead of Quantity.

purchaseDate.description: Omit or null to use the current UTC date.
Omit or null to leave the existing purchase date unchanged.

movementSource.description: 1 = Purchase (auto In), 2 = Sale (auto Out), 3 = Manual (MovementType required)

movementType.description:
Required only when MovementSource = 3 (Manual).
1 = In (adds stock), 2 = Out (removes stock), 3 = Adjustment (no qty change, record only).
Ignored for Purchase and Sale — direction is auto-derived.

movementDate.description: Omit or null to use the current UTC date.

movementSource.description: 1 = Purchase (auto In), 2 = Sale (auto Out), 3 = Manual (MovementType required)

movementType.description: Required only when MovementSource = 3 (Manual). 1 = In, 2 = Out, 3 = Adjustment.

movementDate.description: Omit or null to leave the existing movement date unchanged.

notificationType.description: Notification type key from the catalog (e.g. "order_delivered").

templateVars.description: Template variable substitutions (e.g. orderId, clientName, amount).

isManual.description: True only for manually-created entries — controls edit/delete eligibility on the frontend.

transDate.description: Required. Replaces the existing transaction date.

Bearer.description: Enter your JWT access token (without the 'Bearer ' prefix).
